build.locales: FormatJS default Chromium subset; magrinj shipping compiled data
build.magrinjBootstrap: Precompiled Hermes -O bytecode, from pinned source
build.overlap: Identical precompiled Hermes -O bytecode on all hosts

clock: __now when available; otherwise Date.now. Calibration >=50 ms; median of seven rounds.
order: Three complete 27-case runs alternate before/after/magrinj then reverse. No builds or profiling during timings.
outputChecks: All Native before/after values match. Comparator differs only on known unsupported qzz locale (en-US versus en).

lazyOnly.description: First isolated step: defer immutable scalar snapshot, retain duplicate canonicalization.
